skill.summary: Comprehensive MERN code review with project health checks and security-focused findings.
skill.author: 9tykeshav

security_audit.summary: The high static score is driven by markdown examples, checklists, and reference snippets for defensive MERN code review. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, destructive behavior, or executable malicious payload in the reviewed skill content.

remediation.issue: Static scanners may flag dangerous examples in markdown reference material.
remediation.suggestion: Label vulnerable examples clearly as non-executable review guidance and keep them inside fenced or quoted documentation sections.

remediation.issue: The skill asks reviewers to run local project-health commands.
remediation.suggestion: State that commands should be run only with user permission and in the target repository scope.

content.value_statement: MERN projects can hide security, testing, and architecture problems across several layers. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured reviews with actionable findings.
actual_capabilities: Checks project health before detailed code review, including build status, tests, file size, and dependency signals.
Reviews MERN security patterns such as NoSQL injection, XSS, JWT storage, CORS, rate limiting, and secrets handling.
Flags maintainability problems including large files, complex functions, duplicated code, and unclear module boundaries.
Assesses performance risks in React, Express, MongoDB, and Node.js code paths.
Produces a structured report with severity groups, file references, reasoning, and suggested fixes.
Uses focused reference files only when MERN-specific context is needed.
limitations: It depends on the assistant having access to the relevant repository files and command permissions.
It does not replace human review for business logic, product intent, or compliance signoff.
It may not run every test or build command unless the user grants permission and the environment supports them.
It is optimized for MERN projects and may be less precise for unrelated stacks.

use_cases.title: Pre-merge MERN pull request review
use_cases.description: Review changed React, Express, MongoDB, and Node.js files before merging a feature branch.

use_cases.title: Security-focused application audit
use_cases.description: Check a MERN codebase for injection, authentication, secrets, CORS, and XSS risks.

use_cases.title: Project health assessment
use_cases.description: Identify build blockers, missing tests, oversized files, and architecture risks in an existing project.

prompt_templates.title: Review my MERN project
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a broad review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this MERN project for build health, security, maintainability, performance, testing, and architecture issues. Start with the project health checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review a pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current pull request using the code-reviewer skill. Focus on changed files, but include nearby context when it affects correctness or security.

prompt_templates.title: Audit security risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a security-focused MERN review. Prioritize NoSQL injection, XSS, JWT handling, secrets, CORS, rate limiting, and unsafe command execution.

prompt_templates.title: Assess architecture and maintainability
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for technical debt and scaling risks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this MERN codebase for architectural risk, oversized modules, duplicated logic, unclear boundaries, weak tests, and performance bottlenecks. Provide prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Review my Express and React changes before merge.
output: Project health: build not checked, tests present, no deployment blocker found.
Critical: missing auth middleware on an admin route.
Important: React component re-renders on every keystroke due to unstable callbacks.
Suggestion: split a large service into smaller modules.

output_examples.input: Audit this MERN app for security issues.
output: Critical: user-controlled MongoDB operators can bypass authentication.
Important: JWT tokens are stored in localStorage instead of httpOnly cookies.
Suggestion: add Helmet and stricter CORS configuration.

output_examples.input: Check project health before a release.
output: Tests: no tests found for authentication flows.
Blocker: release should wait until compile errors and critical path tests are fixed.

best_practices: Give the assistant access to the changed files, package scripts, and relevant configuration before requesting a review.
Ask for a specific scope, such as full repository, pull request, last commit, or single file.
Run the recommended build and test commands after fixes to confirm the review findings are resolved.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a release verdict without allowing build, test, and dependency checks.
Do not treat style-only suggestions as blockers unless they affect maintainability or correctness.
Do not use this skill as the only approval for security-sensitive or regulated changes.

faq.question: What projects is this skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for MERN projects that use MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js.

faq.question: Can it review a single file?
faq.answer: Yes. It can perform a deep review of one file and apply relevant checklist items.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: It can recommend or run tests when the environment and permissions allow command execution.

faq.question: Does it fix issues?
faq.answer: It primarily reports findings, but users can ask the assistant to fix prioritized issues afterward.

faq.question: How does it handle security findings?
faq.answer: It prioritizes common MERN risks such as injection, XSS, weak authentication, exposed secrets, and unsafe configuration.

faq.question: Can it replace a human reviewer?
faq.answer: No. It helps find issues faster, but human reviewers should still validate intent, product behavior, and risk acceptance.
